title: Sanctuary Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Sanctuary is a 1 BR / 2 BA / 2 Guest cottage in Seaside, FL. Complimentary in appearance to a small beachside chapel, the ‘Sanctuary’ cottage invokes images of peaceful serenity in Seaside, with a location that’s hard to top.
description_expanded: Description2330 East County Highway 30A1 KINGWelcome to Sanctuary — A Beachfront Retreat in Seaside, FloridaPerfectly positioned directly on the sand, Sanctuary is a rare beachfront cottage in Seaside, Florida that offers unmatched Gulf views, serene design, and a truly intimate escape. Complementary in appearance to a charming seaside chapel, this thoughtfully designed cottage is ideal for couples or solo travelers seeking a peaceful, adults-only retreat (25+). With panoramic ocean views and one of the most coveted locations in Seaside, Sanctuary delivers a calming, elevated coastal experience from the moment you arrive.Coastal Design with a Calm, Minimalist AestheticWrapped in crisp white both inside and out, Sanctuary’s interiors feel airy, tranquil, and intentionally uncluttered. Natural wood floors pair beautifully with whitewashed walls, ceilings, and décor to create a soothing beachside atmosphere that lets the Gulf views take center stage. Every detail is designed to promote relaxation and simplicity, making it easy to disconnect and unwind.Primary King Suite with Spa-Inspired ComfortThe main level of the cottage features a recently renovated king primary bedroom, complete with custom built-in closets, generous storage, and a large flat-screen TV. The ensuite bathroom elevates the experience with a luxurious rain shower, offering a spa-like escape after a day on the beach. Built-ins throughout the suite keep the space organized and serene, allowing you to focus on rest and relaxation.Private Screened Porch with Outdoor Soaking TubJust off the primary bedroom, a private screened-in porch reveals one of Sanctuary’s most indulgent features: a deep soaking bathtub surrounded by privacy screens. This outdoor oasis is perfect for unwinding under the open sky, making the cottage especially appealing for romantic getaways and honeymoon-worthy stays.Elevated Living Spaces with Gulf ViewsUpstairs, breathtaking beachfront views greet you as you enter the open-concept living area. The designer-furnished living room features a wrap-around sofa, high ceilings, abundant natural light, and a large flat-screen TV. Step onto the private balcony for dining for two or simply soak in the sweeping Gulf vistas while listening to the waves.The fully renovated kitchen is seamlessly integrated into the living space and thoughtfully designed to maximize efficiency and style. It features top-of-the-line appliances, a five-burner stove, farmhouse sink, under-mount microwave, and a cozy dining table for two—perfect for quiet meals at home.A Front-Row Seat to Seaside SunsetsJust steps from the living room, the private beachfront balcony is the true highlight of Sanctuary. With high-top dining for two and unobstructed Gulf views, this space is ideal for sunrise coffee, sunset cocktails, or simply enjoying the sound of the waves from the privacy of your own beachfront perch.An Adults-Only Beachfront EscapeWith its unbeatable beachfront location, serene design, and romantic amenities, Sanctuary offers a one-of-a-kind Seaside vacation experience. Whether you’re celebrating a special occasion or simply craving quiet moments by the sea, this adults-only cottage provides the perfect setting for rest, reflection, and unforgettable coastal memories.* 3 night minimum Spring, Spring Break, Summer, and 2 night minimum Fall & Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration. FEATURESFeatures 672 square feet of thoughtfully designed living spaceSeaside Private Residential Beach at East Ruskin PavilionBeachfront location with 1-minute walk, just 75 feet to beach accessAdults-only retreat (not suitable for children)WiFi access throughout the cottageCompact refrigerator for light meals and refreshmentsNo washer or dryer on sitePeacock Alley Linens – fresh, luxurious Peacock Alley towels and sheets throughout the homeAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote with 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities providedGolf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited; special circumstances and medical needs requests require a golf cart permitSTR23-002233
